sn12.31:3.1: The Buddha has already given a brief answer to the question. Here he asks for a detailed response. This is presumably as a teaching tool: the dialogue was probably in front of an assembly.
sn12.31:3.2: Sāriputta hesitates, according to the commentary, because he is unsure of the mode of analysis that the Buddha wants him to pursue.
sn12.31:7.1: See [mn38:9.1](), where “this” refers to dependently originated consciousness.
